how_we_use_this: Rules we take into the next card.

rules.rule: Backup safeties do not equal 250 passing yards.
rules.next: Do not build a passing script off a name on the injury report. Need snaps and who actually covers.

rules.rule: A short-week road favorite can look dead even when the name is bigger.
rules.next: Fade or pass the short-week favorite unless rest and travel lean our way.

rules.from: FAMU at MIA / VILL at LOU / NORF at UVA
rules.rule: A 50-point FCS win is not a license to lay 35-plus the next Friday.
rules.next: Treat a 40-point FCS number as a bench bet.

rules.rule: A plus-money dog still needs the starter to keep it close.
rules.next: Do not bet a depth-arm dog unless the favorite is also throwing a short start.

rules.rule: A total that lands on the number is a trap when the board is a round 8.
rules.next: If the total is a whole number and soft, take the half-point or pass.

rules.from: COL at DET / HOU at TB / PIT at CHC
rules.rule: A three-hit night is not a homer. Do not force a HR on a name.
rules.next: HR tickets need launch angle, park, or wind. Name alone is not enough.

rules.rule: A -200 home favorite can still lose 3-2.
rules.next: If the juice is that heavy and the lean is weak, pass or take the dog.
